qorqonaγ-žubur-a: Qorqonaγ-Žubur — Qorqonaq-Jubur, a place name; dative-locative -a, 'at, in' (name + case; Ming 地名) [地名(裏)]

urida: urida — formerly, before, in front (adverb) [在前]

ögčü: ög- — to give; converb -čü after a consonant, 'giving' (verb, converb) [與着]
temüžin-ü: Temüžin — Temüjin; genitive -ü, 'Temüjin's' (name + case, front-vowel form) [人名 的]
bolulčažu: bolulča- — to agree, come to terms (stem inferred; Ming 相從); converb -žu, 'agreeing' (verb, converb) [相從着]
keġeldügsen: keġe- — to say; reciprocal -ldü-, participle -gsen, 'that have said to one another, mutually declared' (verb, reciprocal participle) [相說的]

tende: tende — there, then (from tere 'that'; locative adverb) [那裏]
keġeldüleġei: keġe- — to say; reciprocal -ldü- ('together') + past -leġei, 'have said' (Ming 來; verb, reciprocal past; the ending's force is uncertain) [共說來麽]

daγ̇utu: daγ̇u — voice, sound (noun; Ming 聲); possessive -tu, 'having a sound' [聲有的]
temüžin-e: Temüžin — Temüjin, a man's name; dative-locative -e, 'to Temüjin' (personal name + case) [人名 行]
josun: josun — custom, reason, the right way (noun) [理]

sonosču: sonos- — to hear, listen; converb -ču, 'hearing' (verb, converb) [聽着]

ülü: ülü — not (negates present or converb forms) [不] · also before participles (ülü boluqui, ülü ögteküi), 'not'
keġen: keġe- — to say; keġen 'saying', the converb that closes a quotation (verb, converb) [麽道]
keġeldüžü: keġe- — to say; -ldü- 'together' + converb -žü, 'saying together' (verb, reciprocal converb) [共說着]

anda-da: anda — sworn brother, pledged friend; dative-locative -da, 'to the sworn brother' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [契合 行]
toγtoγ̇a-jin: Toγtoγ̇a — Toqto'a, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel-final stem, 'of Toqto'a' (personal name + case) [人名 的]
unuγ̇ulba: unu- — to ride; causative -γul-, past -ba, 'made ride' (verb, causative past) [敎騎了]
uwas-merkid-ün: Uwas-Merkid — the Uwas Merkid, the Uwas clan of the Merkid; genitive -ün, 'of the Uwas Merkid' (clan name + case) [姓氏 種名 的]
dair-usun: Dair-Usun — Dair-Usun, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
kü: kü — just, indeed (emphatic particle) [只] · also with the Ming 也 'also, too' (in Ede ber ... kü kürülčežü), the same emphatic force, 'indeed' (uncertain)

saγlaγar: saγlaγar — thick, bushy, dense (Ming 鬔鬆 'shaggy'; word class uncertain) [鬔鬆]

teriġün: teriġün — head, first (noun) [頭] · also 'source' (Ming 源), of a river

žirγoγ̇an-a: žirγoγan — six; dative -a, 'on the sixth' (numeral + dative, a date marker) [六行]
tergel: tergel — circle (noun; the Ming reads 圖兒, uncertain) [(圖)兒]
neġübe: neġü- — to move camp; past -be, 'moved camp' (verb, past tense) [起了]
qamtu: qamtu — together, jointly (adverb) [一同] · also glossed Ming 一箇 'one' ('together' remains the reading; sense uncertain)
jabužu: jabu- — to go, travel; converb -žu, 'going' (verb, converb) [行着]
aisurun: aisu- — to come; converb of time -run, 'when coming' (verb, converb) [來時]
ügülerün: ügüle- — to speak, to say; converb -rün, 'saying' [說]
baγ̇uja: baγ̇u- — to come down, to descend; hortative -ja, 'let us come down' (verb, hortative, back-vowel form) [(下)咱]
bidan-u: bidan-u — of us, our (bida 'we, inclusive', stem bidan-, + genitive -u, back-vowel form) [咱的]
keġebe: keġe- — to say; past -be, 'said' (verb, past tense) [說了]
žamuqa-jin: Žamuqa — Jamuqa, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel-final stem, 'of Jamuqa' (personal name + case) [人名 的]
üge-ji: üge — word, speech; accusative -ji, 'the word (object)' (noun + case) [言語 行]
jadažu: jada- — to be in want, to lack; converb -žu (verb, converb) [窮乏着] · also jada- 'to be unable', converb -žu, 'being unable' (Ming 不得着, 不能着), as in köġüd(i)-jen gelin jadažu, 'unable to drive off'

baižu: bai- — to stand, stay; converb -žu, 'standing' (verb, converb) [立着]

höġelün: Höġelün — Högelün, a woman's name (personal name) [婦人名]

ügülebe: ügüle- — to speak, say; past -be, 'spoke' (verb, past tense) [說了]
eke-dēče: eke — mother; ablative -dēče, 'from the mother' (noun + case, front-vowel form; the Ming 處 'place') [母 處]

eke-ji: eke — mother; accusative -ji after a vowel, 'mother (object)' (noun + case) [母 行]
börte-üžin: Börte-Üžin — Börte-Üjin, a woman's name (one two-part name; Ming 婦人名) [婦人名]

anda-jin: anda — sworn brother, pledged friend; genitive -jin after a vowel-final stem, 'of the sworn brother' (noun + case) [契合 的]

bida: bida — we, us (inclusive: you and I; first-person plural pronoun, Ming 咱) [咱]

börte-üžin-ü: Börte-Üžin — Börte-Üjin, a woman's name; genitive -ü, 'of Börte-Üjin' (name + case, front-vowel form) [妻名 的]

ködölžü: ködöl- — to move, to set in motion (stem inferred from the Ming 動着); converb -žü, 'moving' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [動着]
aisuqui-dur: aisu- — to come; participle -qui + dative-locative -dur, 'at the coming, when coming' (verb, participle + case; Ming 來時) [來時]
žaγ̇ura: žaγ̇ur-a — midway, in the middle (žaγ̇ur 'middle' + dative-locative -a, back-vowel form) [路間] · also 'among, between' (Ming 間), in žaba žaγ̇ura dürüžu, 'into the crevice'
mör-tür: mör — track, road; dative-locative -tür, 'on the road' (noun + case; Ming 路行) [路行]
taičiγ̇ud: Taičiγ̇ud — the Taichi'ud, a clan name, (proper name; the ending -d is probably the plural, which the Ming does not mark) [一種(名)]

žüg: žüg — direction, side, place; after a name, 'toward' (noun used as a postposition) [處]
taičiγ̇ud-un: Taičiγ̇ud — the Taichi'ud, a clan; genitive -un, 'of the Taichi'ud' (name + case, back-vowel form after a consonant) [種名的]
nutuγ-tur: nutuγ — camping-ground; dative-locative -tur, 'in the camp' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [營盤 裏]
neretü: nere — name; possessive -tü, 'having a name, named' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [名字有的]
köġün-i: köġün — son; accusative -i, 'the son (object)' (noun + case) [兒子 行]

abuγ̇ad: ab- — to take; converb -uγ̇ad, 'having taken' (verb, converb, linking vowel + -γ̇ad, back-vowel form) [將了]

düližü: düli- — to ride day and night; converb -žü, 'riding on' (verb, converb) [兼行着]
üžeġesü: üže- — to see; conditional converb -ġesü, 'if, when (he) looked' (verb, converb; Ming 看呵) [看呵]

ažuγ̇u: a- — to be; past ažuγ̇u, 'there was, he was' [有來]

baγ̇arin-u: Baγ̇arin — the Ba'arin, a clan; genitive -u, 'of the Baγ̇arin' (clan name + case) [種名 的]
